company.name: Emirates Islamic
company.shortDescription: Emirates Islamic is a financial services institution that provides banking services and wealth management solutions.
company.description: Emirates Islamic is a financial services institution that provides banking services, including personal and business accounts, financing, credit cards, and wealth management solutions. It serves individuals, small businesses, and corporations with financial products that align with Islamic banking principles. The bank also offers digital banking services and investment solutions while supporting economic growth through Islamic finance.
